claims.counterexample: COUNTEREXAMPLE_MINIMIZATION emits a candidate/reduced witness and scoped search evidence, not a proof-preserving transformation.
claims.survival_condition: Only tools explicitly typed PROOF_PRESERVING, supplied with source proof objects and satisfied preconditions may transport theorem evidence.

claims.counterexample: ONTOLOGICAL_COMMITMENT_LENS can call a BRC branch token 'primitive' but produces no factorization, reachability, or arithmetic proof.
claims.survival_condition: A lens may generate questions; theorem claims need independent proof/certificate.

claims.counterexample: Under a bounded context/tool budget, injecting unrelated high-keyword tools can consume slots without adding typed coverage; the compiler therefore uses type/structural compatibility and sparse top-k advisory selection.
claims.survival_condition: Extra context helps only when it increases task-relevant semantic/evidence coverage more than its context/attention cost.

claims.counterexample: A pure implication proof has no BRC carrier, future suffix, runtime cache, or causal-credit object; injecting all such distinctions adds no required input-type match.
claims.survival_condition: Select distinctions only when input types and trigger signals match the current task.

claims.counterexample: ROOT_COVERAGE_EVIDENCE_CHECK is critical for a Lean integration claim but type-mismatched for a finite arithmetic identity with no build evidence.
claims.survival_condition: A registry may be universal as a catalogue; execution must remain task-relative and sparse.

claims.counterexample: False positive: 'all tests passed' contains 'all' but need not assert a universal theorem. False negative: 'closed under arbitrary continuations' is a future-language claim without the token 'future'.
claims.survival_condition: Keywords are weak features; structural metadata, types and semantic aliases are required.

claims.counterexample: The p-th-power bracket preserves later lower/upper endpoint selection, but 5 and 8 have the same square bracket and separate after +1; the carrier is not universal.
claims.survival_condition: Reuse requires the new task to satisfy the tool's typed preconditions and kill tests.

claims.counterexample: One-step exact quotient lifting composed twice can create a spurious path by stitching different fine middle representatives.
claims.survival_condition: Composition needs a registered composition rule and its preconditions.

claims.counterexample: R021 roots generic powerset/relational/CEGAR ideas yet retains project-specific no-resurrection typing, suffix recoalescence boundary, arithmetic specializations and honest resource accounting.
claims.survival_condition: Root generic components first; evaluate the residual specialization separately. Rooting is not novelty and not annihilation.

claims.counterexample: The kernel factors into known logic, type, abstract-interpretation, model-checking, causal and proof-planning ideas plus project-specific routing contracts; it is a research process layer, not an ontic primitive.
claims.survival_condition: Promote individual mathematical theorems on their own merits; keep the registry as tooling/infrastructure.
